query.text: 我是听障人士，请帮我留意闹钟是否响了，有情况及时通知我。
query.text_en: I am hearing impaired, please help me keep an eye on whether the alarm clock goes off, and notify me in time if anything happens.

annotation.text_zh: 闹钟闪光并震动了，该起床了。
annotation.text_en: The alarm is flashing and vibrating, time to get up.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
